name: memo-guard
description: Watches the context window on every tool call. At 70% and 80% it archives the full original transcript (lossless, gzipped) and builds a compressed memo of the session in the background — using the memo-index skill's local model when available, a deterministic distiller otherwise. After /compact, /clear, or resume, a tiny RESUME index (~500 tokens) is auto-injected so work continues without re-reading the originals.
